headline: Trump declares 100 percent tariffs on many drones and all aircraft parts
summary: President Trump announced 100% tariffs on numerous drone imports. Tariffs also apply to all aircraft parts, significantly raising costs. This action expands existing bans on foreign tech, including drones and robots.

headline: Apple and Epic argue over how much Apple should get from purchases made outside the App Store
summary: Apple proposed collecting fees on digital purchases made via external links. This is part of its ongoing legal dispute with Epic Games. Epic Games rejected the proposal, calling Apple's request "far outside of the bounds."

headline: ‘That is not acceptable’: Judge orders Google to make rival app store installs easier
summary: A judge ordered Google to simplify the installation of rival app stores on Android. The ruling stems from the ongoing legal battle with Epic Games. This decision aims to increase competition in the Android app distribution market.

headline: The fight over Flock and other ALPRs
summary: Over 120,000 Flock automatic license plate reader (ALPR) cameras are deployed in the US. These AI-powered cameras track vehicles by license plate, make, model, and color. The networked system raises significant concerns about privacy and surveillance.

summary: Multiple devastating fires have destroyed homes across the West Midlands. Fire services received thousands of 999 calls during the crisis. The incidents are among the most significant in the region's history, according to the fire chief.

headline: Two seriously hurt as passenger train derails in East Sussex
summary: A passenger train derailed in East Sussex, seriously injuring two people. Witnesses described the scene as "pandemonium" as carriages rocked. Emergency services responded to the incident, with investigations underway.

summary: South-east England experiences its final day of heatwave conditions on Friday. Fresher weather is expected across the UK as the weekend begins. Enjoy the last of the high temperatures before a significant cooldown.
